headline: A 2001 executive order set up a federal task force of agencies focused on the District of Columbia.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order created a task force made up of several federal agencies to work on matters involving the District of Columbia. No summary was provided, so its exact duties, members, and goals are not clear from the available information.

who_it_affects.how: Some federal agencies were assigned to take part in the task force.

who_it_affects.group: District of Columbia government and residents
who_it_affects.how: The task force was focused on the District of Columbia, though the specific effects on the city are not described in the available information.
